title: Travis Taylor zapped at Skinwalker Ranch
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Travis Taylor zapped at Skinwalker Ranch, about 2020s at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Taylor was mouthing off and they give him this little zap, you know, with the the radioactivities.

plain: Skinwalker Ranch is a property in Utah with a long reputation for strange happenings, and a researcher named Grant Cameron tells a story about it on the podcast of host Jesse Michels. Cameron says that sometime in the 2020s a man there named Travis Taylor was "mouthing off" and was given "a little zap" involving radioactivity, without saying who or what did it. People tell it because, if true, it would suggest that something at the ranch reacts to the people studying it.
